description: Player window (table TV): it may only listen for events and calls no commands. Listening cannot be limited to certain events in Tauri, so it can hear every global event of the app – which is why no global event may carry library or campaign data (DM-only data goes through channels). It receives the projected scene from the DM window and validates it with the strict player-view schema; library images come through the read-only dmlib scheme (DM decision, T-105b).
